1.web: Then six days before the Passover, Jesus came to Bethany, where Lazarus was, who had been dead, whom he raised from the dead.
1.asv: Jesus therefore six days before the passover came to Bethany, where Lazarus was, whom Jesus raised from the dead.

2.web: So they made him a supper there. Martha served, but Lazarus was one of those who sat at the table with him.
2.asv: So they made him a supper there: and Martha served; but Lazarus was one of them that sat at meat with him.

3.web: Mary, therefore, took a pound of ointment of pure nard, very precious, and anointed the feet of Jesus, and wiped his feet with her hair. The house was filled with the fragrance of the ointment.
3.asv: Mary therefore took a pound of ointment of pure nard, very precious, and anointed the feet of Jesus, and wiped his feet with her hair: and the house was filled with the odor of the ointment.

4.web: Then Judas Iscariot, Simon’s son, one of his disciples, who would betray him, said,
4.asv: But Judas Iscariot, one of his disciples, that should betray him, saith,

5.web: “Why wasn’t this ointment sold for three hundred denarii, and given to the poor?”
5.asv: Why was not this ointment sold for three hundred shillings, and given to the poor?

6.web: Now he said this, not because he cared for the poor, but because he was a thief, and having the money box, used to steal what was put into it.
6.asv: Now this he said, not because he cared for the poor; but because he was a thief, and having the bag took away what was put therein.

7.web: But Jesus said, “Leave her alone. She has kept this for the day of my burial.
7.asv: Jesus therefore said, Suffer her to keep it against the day of my burying.

8.web: For you always have the poor with you, but you don’t always have me.”
8.asv: For the poor ye have always with you; but me ye have not always.

9.web: A large crowd therefore of the Jews learned that he was there, and they came, not for Jesus’ sake only, but that they might see Lazarus also, whom he had raised from the dead.
9.asv: The common people therefore of the Jews learned that he was there: and they came, not for Jesus’ sake only, but that they might see Lazarus also, whom he had raised from the dead.

10.web: But the chief priests conspired to put Lazarus to death also,
10.asv: But the chief priests took counsel that they might put Lazarus also to death;

11.web: because on account of him many of the Jews went away and believed in Jesus.
11.asv: because that by reason of him many of the Jews went away, and believed on Jesus.

12.web: On the next day a great multitude had come to the feast. When they heard that Jesus was coming to Jerusalem,
12.asv: On the morrow a great multitude that had come to the feast, when they heard that Jesus was coming to Jerusalem,

13.web: they took the branches of the palm trees, and went out to meet him, and cried out, “Hosanna! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord, the King of Israel!”
13.asv: took the branches of the palm trees, and went forth to meet him, and cried out, Hosanna: Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord, even the King of Israel.

14.web: Jesus, having found a young donkey, sat on it. As it is written,
14.asv: And Jesus, having found a young ass, sat thereon; as it is written,

15.web: “Don’t be afraid, daughter of Zion. Behold, your King comes, sitting on a donkey’s colt.”
15.asv: Fear not, daughter of Zion: behold, thy King cometh, sitting on an ass’s colt.

16.web: His disciples didn’t understand these things at first, but when Jesus was glorified, then they remembered that these things were written about him, and that they had done these things to him.
16.asv: These things understood not his disciples at the first: but when Jesus was glorified, then remembered they that these things were written of him, and that they had done these things unto him.

17.web: The multitude therefore that was with him when he called Lazarus out of the tomb, and raised him from the dead, was testifying about it.
17.asv: The multitude therefore that was with him when he called Lazarus out of the tomb, and raised him from the dead, bare witness.

18.web: For this cause also the multitude went and met him, because they heard that he had done this sign.
18.asv: For this cause also the multitude went and met him, for that they heard that he had done this sign.

19.web: The Pharisees therefore said among themselves, “See how you accomplish nothing. Behold, the world has gone after him.”
19.asv: The Pharisees therefore said among themselves, Behold how ye prevail nothing; lo, the world is gone after him.

20.web: Now there were certain Greeks among those that went up to worship at the feast.
20.asv: Now there were certain Greeks among those that went up to worship at the feast:

21.web: These, therefore, came to Philip, who was from Bethsaida of Galilee, and asked him, saying, “Sir, we want to see Jesus.”
21.asv: these therefore came to Philip, who was of Bethsaida of Galilee, and asked him, saying, Sir, we would see Jesus.

22.web: Philip came and told Andrew, and in turn, Andrew came with Philip, and they told Jesus.
22.asv: Philip cometh and telleth Andrew: Andrew cometh, and Philip, and they tell Jesus.

23.web: Jesus answered them, “The time has come for the Son of Man to be glorified.
23.asv: And Jesus answereth them, saying, The hour is come, that the Son of man should be glorified.

24.web: Most certainly I tell you, unless a grain of wheat falls into the earth and dies, it remains by itself alone. But if it dies, it bears much fruit.
24.asv: Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except a grain of wheat fall into the earth and die, it abideth by itself alone; but if it die, it beareth much fruit.

25.web: He who loves his life will lose it. He who hates his life in this world will keep it to eternal life.
25.asv: He that loveth his life loseth it; and he that hateth his life in this world shall keep it unto life eternal.

26.web: If anyone serves me, let him follow me. Where I am, there will my servant also be. If anyone serves me, the Father will honor him.
26.asv: If any man serve me, let him follow me; and where I am, there shall also my servant be: if any man serve me, him will the Father honor.

27.web: “Now my soul is troubled. What shall I say? ‘Father, save me from this time?’ But for this cause I came to this time.
27.asv: Now is my soul troubled; and what shall I say? Father, save me from this hour. But for this cause came I unto this hour.

28.web: Father, glorify your name!” Then there came a voice out of the sky, saying, “I have both glorified it, and will glorify it again.”
28.asv: Father, glorify thy name. There came therefore a voice out of heaven, saying, I have both glorified it, and will glorify it again.

29.web: The multitude therefore, who stood by and heard it, said that it had thundered. Others said, “An angel has spoken to him.”
29.asv: The multitude therefore, that stood by, and heard it, said that it had thundered: others said, An angel hath spoken to him.

30.web: Jesus answered, “This voice hasn’t come for my sake, but for your sakes.
30.asv: Jesus answered and said, This voice hath not come for my sake, but for your sakes.

31.web: Now is the judgment of this world. Now the prince of this world will be cast out.
31.asv: Now is the judgment of this world: now shall the prince of this world be cast out.

32.web: And I, if I am lifted up from the earth, will draw all people to myself.”
32.asv: And I, if I be lifted up from the earth, will draw all men unto myself.

33.web: But he said this, signifying by what kind of death he should die.
33.asv: But this he said, signifying by what manner of death he should die.

34.web: The multitude answered him, “We have heard out of the law that the Christ remains forever. How do you say, ‘The Son of Man must be lifted up?’ Who is this Son of Man?”
34.asv: The multitude therefore answered him, We have heard out of the law that the Christ abideth for ever: and how sayest thou, The Son of man must be lifted up? who is this Son of man?

35.web: Jesus therefore said to them, “Yet a little while the light is with you. Walk while you have the light, that darkness doesn’t overtake you. He who walks in the darkness doesn’t know where he is going.
35.asv: Jesus therefore said unto them, Yet a little while is the light among you. Walk while ye have the light, that darkness overtake you not: and he that walketh in the darkness knoweth not whither he goeth.

36.web: While you have the light, believe in the light, that you may become children of light.” Jesus said these things, and he departed and hid himself from them.
36.asv: While ye have the light, believe on the light, that ye may become sons of light. These things spake Jesus, and he departed and hid himself from them.

37.web: But though he had done so many signs before them, yet they didn’t believe in him,
37.asv: But though he had done so many signs before them, yet they believed not on him:

38.web: that the word of Isaiah the prophet might be fulfilled, which he spoke, “Lord, who has believed our report? To whom has the arm of the Lord been revealed?”
38.asv: that the word of Isaiah the prophet might be fulfilled, which he spake, Lord, who hath believed our report? And to whom hath the arm of the Lord been revealed?

39.web: For this cause they couldn’t believe, for Isaiah said again,
39.asv: For this cause they could not believe, for that Isaiah said again,

40.web: “He has blinded their eyes and he hardened their heart, lest they should see with their eyes, and perceive with their heart, and would turn, and I would heal them.”
40.asv: He hath blinded their eyes, and he hardened their heart; Lest they should see with their eyes, and perceive with their heart, And should turn, And I should heal them.

41.web: Isaiah said these things when he saw his glory, and spoke of him.
41.asv: These things said Isaiah, because he saw his glory; and he spake of him.

42.web: Nevertheless even of the rulers many believed in him, but because of the Pharisees they didn’t confess it, so that they wouldn’t be put out of the synagogue,
42.asv: Nevertheless even of the rulers many believed on him; but because of the Pharisees they did not confess it, lest they should be put out of the synagogue:

43.web: for they loved men’s praise more than God’s praise.
43.asv: for they loved the glory that is of men more than the glory that is of God.

44.web: Jesus cried out and said, “Whoever believes in me, believes not in me, but in him who sent me.
44.asv: And Jesus cried and said, He that believeth on me, believeth not on me, but on him that sent me.

45.web: He who sees me sees him who sent me.
45.asv: And he that beholdeth me beholdeth him that sent me.

46.web: I have come as a light into the world, that whoever believes in me may not remain in the darkness.
46.asv: I am come a light into the world, that whosoever believeth on me may not abide in the darkness.

47.web: If anyone listens to my sayings, and doesn’t believe, I don’t judge him. For I came not to judge the world, but to save the world.
47.asv: And if any man hear my sayings, and keep them not, I judge him not: for I came not to judge the world, but to save the world.

48.web: He who rejects me, and doesn’t receive my sayings, has one who judges him. The word that I spoke, the same will judge him in the last day.
48.asv: He that rejecteth me, and receiveth not my sayings, hath one that judgeth him: the word that I spake, the same shall judge him in the last day.

49.web: For I spoke not from myself, but the Father who sent me, he gave me a commandment, what I should say, and what I should speak.
49.asv: For I spake not from myself; but the Father that sent me, he hath given me a commandment, what I should say, and what I should speak.

50.web: I know that his commandment is eternal life. The things therefore which I speak, even as the Father has said to me, so I speak.”
50.asv: And I know that his commandment is life eternal; the things therefore which I speak, even as the Father hath said unto me, so I speak.
